individual_items.label: Whole square master
individual_items.evaluation: The welcoming lavender/aqua grotto, broad pale floor and four empty alcoves retain the existing setting and leave live objects separate. The surplus ceiling/floor frames the central play window. Painted source style is provisionally4.5, with more small rock planes in the ceiling than ideal. Native1254-square fails the mandatory2048-square resolution gate; this is reference-only, not a runtime replacement.

individual_items.label: Central sea opening
individual_items.evaluation: A single clear sky-to-turquoise-sea opening provides a calm central landmark. Soft clouds and broad water bands remain subordinate to foreground actors. No live crystal, fossil or work object is baked into this opening.

individual_items.label: Left outer empty alcove
individual_items.evaluation: Rounded lavender cavity, cream arch and simple supporting shelf are child-readable and high-key. The empty recess can receive a separate existing work object without duplicating painted gameplay props.

individual_items.label: Left inner empty alcove
individual_items.evaluation: The cream arch and aqua lower stone separate this empty recess from the distant central opening. Rounded shelf contact has a visible lavender shadow and follows the room palette.

individual_items.label: Right inner empty alcove
individual_items.evaluation: The separate empty recess and rounded cream support mirror the room grammar without identical mechanical repeated marks. Its pale interior keeps future colored work props readable.

individual_items.label: Right outer empty alcove
individual_items.evaluation: The outer niche preserves the rounded warm rim and cool lavender cavity. The source does not bake in the interactive geode, so the selected authored geode can remain one object.

individual_items.label: Unobstructed floor
individual_items.evaluation: Broad pale warm stone/sand values provide figure-ground separation for small bright characters. The central floor is free of stools, islands, tables, trays and crystals; actor/support contact still requires real mounted review.

individual_items.label: Rock ceiling
individual_items.evaluation: Numerous small faceted painted patches add more texture than the broad-mass design rule prefers. Much lies outside the intended central16:9 play window, but the full master still contains this density. Do not infer a live defect from the unused upper region; mounted framing remains untested.

individual_items.label: Outer coral and stone framing
individual_items.evaluation: Sparse aqua coral and lavender corner rock frame the empty floor. The lowest stone triangles are outside most of the central play window. Isolated source framing reaches the floor provisionally; phone presentation and occlusion are unreviewed.

qualification: One complete returned image directly inspected, nine individually written source/component opinions. Source score never waives native coverage; no production binding, complete action, device/child/owner, finding or all-job acceptance.
